name: Coupa
description: Coupa is a cloud-based business spend management (BSM) platform unifying procurement, sourcing and contracting, services procurement, AP automation, expense management, payments, inventory, and supply chain design/planning, with AI-driven insights and agents it markets under the "Coupa AI" brand. Coupa states its platform has processed $9 trillion in transactions across a community of more than 10 million buyers and suppliers, and that 55% of the Fortune 500 work with Coupa.
best_for: Large and enterprise organizations that want to unify procurement, sourcing, AP/invoicing, expense management, payments, and supply chain planning on one platform with centralized spend visibility, rather than a self-serve, per-user product.
features: Intake & Orchestration and Procurement: guided buying, purchase requisitions/orders, and real-time spend tracking across a single platform
Source-to-Contract: sourcing optimization, supplier evaluation, and contract creation from one workflow
Services Procurement for tracking, managing, and onboarding contingent/non-employee workforce spend
AP Automation with compliance-as-a-service to help keep invoice processing current with tax and industry regulations
Expense management with automated policy workflows aimed at reducing maverick spend
Payments, with unified visibility across spend, payments, and liquidity
Inventory management covering on-hand balances and automated fulfillment
Spend analysis with AI-driven insights and peer benchmarking
Supply chain design and planning using machine learning and generative-AI scenario modeling
Coupa AI: AI agents and automation (including a generative-AI agent Coupa calls Navi) applied across procurement, finance, and supply chain workflows
pros: Wide product breadth spans procurement, AP, expense, payments, sourcing/contracting, and supply chain planning in one platform, per Coupa
Coupa reports 3,200+ customers, $1B+ in annual revenue, and that 55% of the Fortune 500 work with Coupa
cons: No published pricing tiers or dollar figures anywhere on Coupa's site — Coupa's own /pricing URL redirects to its homepage, and every pricing path leads to "Get a Custom Demo" or "Contact Us" rather than a self-serve quote
Positioned and priced for large enterprise spend volumes rather than self-serve small-business use

tiers.name: Coupa Business Spend Management Platform
tiers.notes: No self-serve pricing page is published — Coupa's own /pricing URL redirects to its homepage, and every pricing path ("Get a Custom Demo", "Contact Us") routes to a sales conversation. No tiers, dollar amounts, or per-user figures are disclosed publicly.

alternatives.name: SAP Concur
alternatives.description: SAP's travel, expense, and invoice management suite with published starting per-report prices on its entry tiers and custom quotes for its fullest tier.
alternatives.best_for: Companies that want to automate travel booking, expense reporting, and invoice/AP processing with policy enforcement and audit controls.
strengths: Published starting prices on entry tiers
Mobile app for expenses, travel, and approvals
AI-assisted receipt matching and audit flagging

alternatives.name: Stampli
alternatives.description: An accounts payable automation platform centered on invoice communication and approval collaboration, with AI-assisted coding and matching.
alternatives.best_for: Finance teams that want AP automation and approval collaboration layered onto their existing ERP or accounting system.
strengths: AP-focused rather than full spend-management suite
Integrates with a wide range of existing ERPs

alternatives.name: BILL
alternatives.description: A financial operations platform for small and midsize businesses combining a free corporate card with subscription-based accounts payable and receivable automation.
alternatives.best_for: Small and midsize businesses wanting AP/AR automation and a free corporate card rather than an enterprise spend-management suite.
strengths: Free corporate card product with no subscription fee
Published self-serve AP & AR pricing tiers
Two-way sync with QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, and Microsoft Dynamics

alternatives.name: NetSuite
alternatives.description: Oracle's cloud ERP system unifying accounting, inventory, and order management with multi-subsidiary financial consolidation.
alternatives.best_for: Growing and mid-market companies wanting procurement and financials built into a single core ERP rather than a standalone spend-management platform.
strengths: Single system for financials, inventory, and procurement
